title: Lookup Flow
markdown:
### Lookup Flow

**Example · Chaining + Dictionary**：m=5，h(k)=k mod 5；T[3]：(13,Alice) → (18,Bob) → (23,Carol)

```svg
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 454 278" width="454" height="278" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet">
<title>Chaining lookup: get key 18</title>
<desc>Hash function finds bucket 3. The linked list then compares original keys 13 and 18. Match returns Bob.</desc>
<rect x="2" y="2" width="450" height="274" rx="6" fill="var(--nodal-svg-surface)" stroke="var(--nodal-svg-border)" stroke-width="1.2"/>
<text x="16" y="29" fill="var(--nodal-svg-text)" font-size="17" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-weight="bold">Lookup: get(18)</text>
<text x="16" y="49" fill="var(--nodal-svg-muted)" font-size="11" font-family="Arial, sans-serif">m = 5  |  h(k) = k mod 5</text>
<rect x="16" y="62" width="116" height="40" rx="6" fill="var(--nodal-svg-surface)" stroke="var(--nodal-svg-border)" stroke-width="1.2"/>
<text x="74" y="87" fill="var(--nodal-svg-text)" font-size="13" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">get(18)</text>
<line x1="136" y1="82" x2="164" y2="82" stroke="var(--nodal-svg-accent)" stroke-width="1.7" stroke-linecap="round"/><path d="M159 78 L164 82 L159 86" fill="none" stroke="var(--nodal-svg-accent)" stroke-width="1.7" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
<rect x="170" y="62" width="116" height="40" rx="6" fill="var(--nodal-svg-accent-surface)" stroke="var(--nodal-svg-accent)" stroke-width="1.2"/>
<text x="228" y="87" fill="var(--nodal-svg-text)" font-size="13" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">h(18) = 3</text>
<line x1="290" y1="82" x2="317" y2="82" stroke="var(--nodal-svg-accent)" stroke-width="1.7" stroke-linecap="round"/><path d="M312 78 L317 82 L312 86" fill="none" stroke="var(--nodal-svg-accent)" stroke-width="1.7" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
<rect x="323" y="62" width="116" height="40" rx="6" fill="var(--nodal-svg-surface)" stroke="var(--nodal-svg-border)" stroke-width="1.2"/>
<text x="381" y="87" fill="var(--nodal-svg-text)" font-size="13" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">T[3]</text>
<text x="17" y="126" fill="var(--nodal-svg-text)" font-size="12" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-weight="bold">Compare the original Keys in bucket 3:</text>
<rect x="16" y="141" width="116" height="64" rx="6" fill="var(--nodal-svg-warning-surface)" stroke="var(--nodal-svg-warning)" stroke-width="1.2"/>
<text x="26" y="166" fill="var(--nodal-svg-text)" font-size="13" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-weight="bold">Key: 13</text>
<text x="26" y="188" fill="var(--nodal-svg-text)" font-size="12" font-family="Arial, sans-serif">Value: Alice</text>
<line x1="135" y1="173" x2="163" y2="173" stroke="var(--nodal-svg-accent)" stroke-width="1.7" stroke-linecap="round"/><path d="M158 169 L163 173 L158 177" fill="none" stroke="var(--nodal-svg-accent)" stroke-width="1.7" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
<rect x="170" y="141" width="116" height="64" rx="6" fill="var(--nodal-svg-success-surface)" stroke="var(--nodal-svg-success)" stroke-width="1.2"/>
<text x="180" y="166" fill="var(--nodal-svg-text)" font-size="13" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-weight="bold">Key: 18</text>
<text x="180" y="188" fill="var(--nodal-svg-text)" font-size="12" font-family="Arial, sans-serif">Value: Bob</text>
<line x1="289" y1="173" x2="317" y2="173" stroke="var(--nodal-svg-muted)" stroke-width="1.7" stroke-linecap="round"/><path d="M312 169 L317 173 L312 177" fill="none" stroke="var(--nodal-svg-muted)" stroke-width="1.7" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
<rect x="324" y="141" width="116" height="64" rx="6" fill="var(--nodal-svg-surface)" stroke="var(--nodal-svg-border)" stroke-width="1.2"/>
<text x="334" y="166" fill="var(--nodal-svg-text)" font-size="13" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-weight="bold">Key: 23</text>
<text x="334" y="188" fill="var(--nodal-svg-text)" font-size="12" font-family="Arial, sans-serif">Value: Carol</text>
<text x="334" y="201" fill="var(--nodal-svg-muted)" font-size="8.5" font-family="Arial, sans-serif">not visited</text>
<rect x="16" y="220" width="422" height="39" rx="6" fill="var(--nodal-svg-success-surface)" stroke="var(--nodal-svg-success)" stroke-width="1.2"/>
<text x="28" y="245" fill="var(--nodal-svg-text)" font-size="13" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-weight="bold">13 != 18   |   18 = 18   |   Result: Bob</text>
</svg>
```

- get(18)：18 mod 5=3 → T[3] → 逐个比较 **Key** → Bob
- put(18,"David")：更新 Value；remove(18)：找到 Key 后删除

*这里只展示 Key–Value + Chaining 的一种实现，不代表所有 Hash Tables*
